title: Implement True PNG Asset Drop Zones Across the Hero Section and All Storefront Sections
description: Per user directive ('hero section and other sections does not have png drop zones where we can place pngs to make my desiger place the pngs'), replaced simulated SVGs, mock furniture drawings, and complex CSS mockups (e.g. simulated credenzas, SVG geometric abstract art, armchair illustrations) across the Hero Section and all storefront sections with clean, unmistakable, prominent dashed PNG Drop Zones. Each drop zone features high-visibility dashed borders, prominent upload/image icons in gold accent, bold uppercase titles, exact designer instructions with target file paths, aspect ratios and dimensions (16:9 1920×1080, 4:3 1200×900 / 800×600, 3:4 600×800, 1:1 1080×1080), and 300 DPI high-resolution format specifications. All existing test IDs and interactive behaviors were preserved, achieving 65/65 passing Playwright tests and 0 build errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero Section (components/hero/hero-carousel.tsx): Replace simulated SVGs, credenzas, and CSS mockups with prominent dashed PNG drop zones (border-4 border-dashed, min-h-[380px] sm:min-h-[460px], UploadCloud icon, bold uppercase title, designer instructions text with target path, spec badge, data-testid='hero-png-dropzone')

Custom Frame Studio (components/hero/live-frame-switcher.tsx): Replace simulated botanical SVG with an Interactive Frame & Artwork PNG Drop Zone (border-3 border-dashed, min-h-[300px] sm:min-h-[360px], UploadCloud icon, live configuration chips, data-testid='frame-png-dropzone')

Customer Lookbook (components/home/customer-lookbook.tsx): Replace simulated SVG furniture and wall drawings with a Full-Bleed Architectural Scene PNG Drop Zone (16:9 • 1920×1080) with floating interactive hotspot pins and cards, data-testid='lookbook-scene-dropzone'

Curated Projects & Capabilities (components/home/frame-card.tsx): Replace simulated SVG artwork in product cards with prominent Project PNG Drop Zones (800×600) and In-Situ Scene PNG Drop Zones (1200×900) retaining all test IDs

Framing Journey Workflow (components/home/framing-journey.tsx): Replace mini SVG diagrams with clean Process Step Diagram PNG Drop Zones in each of the 4 step cards (data-testid='journey-step-dropzone-*')

Featured Products Carousel (components/home/featured-products-carousel.tsx) & Highlight (app/page.tsx): Unambiguous dashed drop zones (border-3 border-dashed, 3:4 600×800) with data-testid='featured-product-png-dropzone' and data-testid='featured-product-canvas-dropzone'
Trust Bar (components/home/trust-bar.tsx): Prominent dashed badge drop zones for CNC / Archival / Turnkey / GeM badges
Zero TypeScript and 0 build errors across Next.js compilation
All Playwright tests pass (65/65 passed with 0 regressions)
Playwright test spec tests/task-23-dropzones.spec.ts captures high-res screenshots for dark, light, and mobile viewports saved to .agent/screenshots/ and parent brain directory
